title: LQQ3: London-session vs overnight returns (flat-at-close rule)
agenda_item: Owner request: never hold positions over a market close
hypothesis: A 3x Nasdaq ETP held only while London is open (flat at every close) keeps most of the return.
rationale: Tests the cost of the owner's proposed flat-at-close constraint before building it.
methodology: Daily open->close vs close->next-open returns; 0.15% per side on each round trip; trend variant uses QQQ > 100-day SMA known before the open.
robustness: with and without the trend filter
limitations: Yahoo LSE open prices can be stale first trades
decision_detail: Flat-at-close loses heavily: almost all of LQQ3's return arrives overnight (it includes the US afternoon), and a daily round trip's spread exceeds the daytime gain. Owner chose to keep holding overnight.
